supplied_context.provenance: supplied with the case; not perceived by any recorder
supplied_context.road_environment: urban junction, STOP sign for A

time.t_local_s: seconds on the recorder's own clock (0 = that recorder's first sample)
time.t_global_s: seconds on the common clock of the aligned recorders: t_global_s = t_local_s + offset_to_global_s; 0 is the time-origin collision (the strongest collision reported by two recorders and matched between them); null when the recorder could not be aligned

frames.recorder_frame: each recorder has its own fixed frame: origin = its first position, x = its first heading, y = 90 degrees to the right of x; frames of different recorders are not related to each other
frames.vehicle_frame: longitudinal = along the recorder's current heading (+ ahead), lateral = across it (+ to the right)
frames.angles: degrees; positive = clockwise seen from above (to the right)

EGO_MOTION.acceleration_mps2: rate of change of that speed (+ speeding up)
EGO_MOTION.yaw_rate_dps: rate of change of heading (+ turning right)
EGO_MOTION.heading_deg: heading in the recorder's frame (0 = its first heading)

TRACK_STATE.observed_subject: who the track is: a recorder id when identity_status is ASSOCIATED, otherwise the track's own id (an unidentified road user)
TRACK_STATE.local_track_id: the radar track of the recorder, as <recorder>:track_NNN
TRACK_STATE.identity_status: ASSOCIATED = identified with a recorder; ANONYMOUS = not identified
TRACK_STATE.radar: which of the recorder's radars measured the track at that instant
TRACK_STATE.range_m: horizontal distance from that radar to the tracked point
TRACK_STATE.clearance_m: free distance from the recorder's body to the near surface of the tracked road user
TRACK_STATE.bearing_deg: direction of the tracked point from the recorder's heading (+ right, - left)
TRACK_STATE.longitudinal_m/lateral_m: position of the tracked point in the vehicle frame
TRACK_STATE.x_m/y_m: position of the tracked point in the recorder's frame
TRACK_STATE.vx_mps/vy_mps: velocity of the tracked road user in the recorder's frame
TRACK_STATE.target_speed_mps: speed of the tracked road user
TRACK_STATE.target_acceleration_mps2: estimated acceleration of the tracked road user (+ speeding up)
TRACK_STATE.relative_longitudinal_speed_mps/relative: velocity of the tracked road user minus the recorder's, in the vehicle frame
TRACK_STATE.pos_std_m/vel_std_mps: one-sigma uncertainty of the position / velocity estimate
TRACK_STATE.measured: true when a radar measurement updated the track at that instant, false when predicted
TRACK_STATE.t_cpa_s: time until the closest approach if both keep their current velocities (negative = past)
TRACK_STATE.d_cpa_m: distance between the tracked point and the recorder's origin at that closest approach
TRACK_STATE.d_cpa_clearance_m: smallest free distance between the two bodies along that straight relative path
TRACK_STATE.closing_speed_mps: rate at which clearance_m shrinks (+ getting closer)
TRACK_STATE.closing_ttc_s: clearance_m / closing_speed_mps, a purely geometric line-of-sight time; null when not getting closer

SIGN_DETECTION.sign_id: a sign tracked by the recorder's camera, as <recorder>:sign-N
SIGN_DETECTION.t_first/t_confirmed/t_last: first detection, confirmed detection, last detection
SIGN_DETECTION.relevant_to_own_path: the detector judged the sign to apply to the recorder's own path (geometry)
SIGN_DETECTION.min_bearing_deg: smallest bearing at which it was seen
SIGN_DETECTION.n_detections: number of camera frames with the detection

COLLISION_OBSERVATION.reports: each recorder's collision-sensor report: local and global time, peak impulse (N*s)
COLLISION_OBSERVATION.participants: the recorders whose reports were matched as the same contact; a single recorder when the other party is unidentified (no matching report from another recorder)
COLLISION_OBSERVATION.matching: how the reports were matched: impulse similarity and confidence
COLLISION_OBSERVATION.time_origin: true for the collision that defines t_global_s = 0
